verdict.rationale: Bundled email forwarding and free SSL are a fair question for a registrar, but nothing in the evidence pack documents either. The pack covers the API, RDAP output, Terraform/SDK DNS tooling, Dynamic DNS and WHOIS privacy, which are adjacent features that do not deliver this story.

support.subject: As a founder, the basics are bundled — email forwarding on my domain and free SSL so the parked-to-launched path costs nothing extra
